campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:6f40c036-95e6-.title: Marketing Ops/AI GTM Engineer
campfire-campfire:ashbyhq:6f40c036-95e6-.description: ABOUT THE ROLE As an AI GTM Engineer / Marketing Operations at Campfire, you’ll be a key driver in scaling our go-to-market engine and revenue infrastructure. You will bridge the gap between strategy and execution, designing, building, and operationalizing systems and processes that enable Sales and Marketing to operate with speed and precision. In this role, you’ll work closely with leadership to deliver scalable execution, reliable data insights, and cross-functional alignment. You will: - Own the marketing and revenue tech stack end to end, from idea through execution and ongoing optimization - Be the AI Engineer in RevOps: applying technical tools, automation, and integrations to support GTM motion - Partner as a trusted operator with GTM teams, surfacing gaps, engineering scalable solutions, and driving adoption This is a hands-on, high-impact role ideal for someone who thrives in a startup environment and wants to build foundational revenue systems from the ground up. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Design, build, and iterate core GTM workflows, automations, and systems (e.g. lead scoring, routing, lead-to-opportunity handoff, campaign attribution) - Maintain and integrate across the revenue tech stack, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and automation across tools (e.g., CRM, marketing automation, analytics) - Translate business requirements from Sales and Marketing into technical designs, build specifications, and roadmaps - Own segment funnel performance reporting and proactively identify friction points and conversion blockers - Develop dashboards, metrics, and alerts to ensure GTM teams have self‑service visibility into performance and levers - Lead process improvement initiatives: identify inefficiencies, propose and pilot new workflows, and scale them broadly REQUIREMENTS - 2+ years of relevant experience in GTM Engineering, Marketing Operations, GTM Operations, Revenue/Sales Operations, or a similar technical operations role at a scaling SaaS/tech company - Strong technical skills: familiarity with CRM systems (Salesforce or HubSpot), and automation tools - Meticulous attention to data quality, integrity, and consistency across systems - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with ability to interface with both technical and non-technical partners - Bias toward action and ability to execute autonomously in an evolving, often ambiguous environment - A builder mindset: enjoys solving problems, automating manual work, and iterating quickly

flynncompanies-flynncompanies:lever:22f6.title: Project Manager Commercial Roofing
flynncompanies-flynncompanies:lever:22f6.description: Project Manager Commercial Roofing Flynn Group of Companies THE FLYNN WAY “The Flynn Way” is the way we do things at Flynn. It is not any one single thing, but rather a collection of behaviors and actions that are influenced by our collective values and beliefs. Values such as safety, honesty, integrity, and doing what we say are deeply ingrained in Flynn’s culture. We have an amazing opportunity for a Commercial Roofing Project Manager This key position will act as a Project Manager in the Commercial Roofing Division and is responsible for providing Project Management Responsibilities for the entire life cycle of their projects and support to other project managers. The Project Manager is a vital connection between all departments and will be the main point of contact for their projects. The Project Manager is responsible for directing, organizing and controlling project activities. They will maximize the efficiency and profit of the project by purchasing materials under budget, offering value engineered options, tracking project schedule and overseeing the disbursement of materials and labor to a particular jobsite. What we offer: · Salary is DOE, competitive · Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance · 401(k) w/ company match · Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance · Life and AD&D Insurance · Paid time off and paid holidays · Vehicle allowance or company truck plus gas card · Health Club membership reimbursement (specific health clubs) · Flynn University: Education & Leadership Development A Day in the Life · Complete responsibility for assigned project from start to finish. · Work with Superintendent to pre-plan the execution of project and develop project schedule. · Manage contracts, develop and ensure that contract language matches prepared estimates. · Prepare project binder for Superintendent and Foreman · Produce, manage, and track the project submittals · Perform material takeoffs · Write RFIs and coordinate communication between the client and the Company · Participate in jobsite walks and meetings with clients and Superintendents · Document, track, and create change orders to ensure payment for all extra work. · Negotiate change orders with clients · Track and manage costs on projects; achieve budgeted profit margins · Update and maintain an accurate project forecast What you bring: · 3-5 years’ experience in Project Management within a Commercial Roofing scope, or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. · Proficiency in Bluebeam and MS office package, including MS Project · Strong leadership qualities · Ability to multi-task and work in a team environment · Strong Communication and organizational skills · Strong blueprint reading skills · Big picture thinking, with excellent negotiation skills · Highly motivated with strong organizational, analytical, problem solving and decision-making abilities · Self-starting and self-motivating with a desire to grow and improve the environment around them · Proactive in looking at the environment and finding a path forward to situations · Customer minded individuals with the ability to manage and maintain Flynn interests Visit our company website at www.https://flynncompanies.com for additional information. Travel WILL be required for this position - up to 50%.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:811a2eb7-189e-.title: Channel Sales Director
jobgether-jobgether:lever:811a2eb7-189e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Channel Sales Director based in Spain. As a Channel Sales Director, you will lead the expansion and growth of a strategic partner ecosystem across EMEA. You will own the channel go-to-market strategy, from identifying and recruiting partners to enabling them and driving sustainable indirect revenue. The role combines senior commercial leadership with enough technical depth to engage credibly around software, hardware, architecture, APIs, and integrations. You will build executive-level relationships, shape joint business plans, and collaborate closely with direct sales, product, engineering, and solutions teams. Your work will directly influence market expansion, pipeline generation, customer outcomes, and overall commercial growth. This is a remote, internationally focused opportunity with significant travel across Europe. Lead the EMEA channel strategy: Define and execute a comprehensive channel go-to-market strategy aligned with commercial objectives and regional growth opportunities. Build the partner ecosystem: Identify, recruit, onboard, and develop strategic partners capable of expanding market reach and delivering strong customer outcomes. Own partner relationships: Establish trusted, executive-level relationships and manage the full partner lifecycle, from initial engagement through long-term growth. Drive indirect revenue: Develop joint business plans, co-selling motions, pipeline-generation initiatives, and other programs that translate partner relationships into measurable revenue. Enable partners technically: Ensure partners have the knowledge, resources, and capabilities required to position, demonstrate, implement, and support solutions effectively. Develop partner programs: Design incentives, enablement initiatives, certification programs, and co-marketing activities that increase partner engagement and commercial performance. Coordinate with direct sales: Align channel and direct sales activity, establish clear territory strategies, and proactively resolve potential channel conflicts. Influence business strategy: Bring partner feedback, customer insights, and market intelligence into product, engineering, and broader business strategy discussions. Measure channel performance: Track revenue, pipeline, partner acquisition, technical certification, satisfaction, and program ROI to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Collaborate across functions: Work closely with product, engineering, solutions, and commercial teams to ensure channel initiatives are technically sound and commercially effective. Requirements: Channel leadership experience: 10+ years of experience in channel, partner, or indirect sales, ideally within technology, manufacturing, distribution, software, SaaS, or hardware environments. Partner ecosystem expertise: Demonstrated success building, scaling, and managing partner ecosystems that generate meaningful revenue and market growth. Commercial leadership: Experience leading teams or cross-functional channel functions spanning both commercial and technical responsibilities. Technical understanding: Comfortable discussing product architecture, APIs, integrations, and technical concepts at a high level with partners and internal stakeholders. Strategic thinking: Strong strategic and analytical capabilities, with the ability to translate market opportunities and partner data into actionable commercial plans. Relationship building: Excellent executive communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills. Customer and market orientation: Ability to understand partner and customer needs and turn market insights into effective channel strategies. Industry experience: Experience selling to departments of transportation or their technology and service vendors would be advantageous. Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering

jobgether-jobgether:lever:ca0cdcf6-c4e6-.title: Senior Technical Customer Support Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ca0cdcf6-c4e6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Customer Support Engineer based in Brazil. This is a senior customer-facing technical role supporting users across Latin America and, when needed, other global regions. You will troubleshoot complex technical issues while helping customers successfully adopt and operate data technologies. The position combines hands-on support engineering with consulting, technical guidance, and cross-functional collaboration. You will interact with customers through tickets, chat, Slack, calls, community channels, and video meetings. Beyond resolving issues, you will contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing, product feedback, and improvements to support practices. The role is ideal for a technically strong, curious professional who enjoys solving challenging problems in a distributed environment. You will have the opportunity to work with databases, OLAP, cloud-native technologies, distributed systems, and modern data platforms. Provide technical support and guidance to users, customers, and prospects through support cases, chat, Slack, community channels, calls, and meetings. Troubleshoot and resolve technical cases while meeting established service-level agreements and maintaining a high standard of customer service. Develop practical solutions involving open-source and cloud-based data technologies and turn learnings into reusable documentation, knowledge-base content, blogs, webinars, meetups, and training materials. Support both pre-sales and post-sales activities, including technically complex proofs of concept and customer engagements. Collaborate with Support, Engineering, Go-to-Market, and Product teams to communicate customer needs and help shape product functionality. Build strong, trusted relationships with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. Mentor colleagues, share technical knowledge, and contribute to the development of the broader support engineering team. Identify recurring issues, process gaps, platform limitations, and opportunities to improve support workflows and customer experience. Provide support coverage according to the scheduling requirements of a global 24x7 support organization. Contribute to continuous improvements in technical support practices, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Requirements Previous experience in a technical customer-facing role such as Support Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Consultant, Database Administrator, Site Reliability Engineer, Software Engineer, or Systems Engineer. Strong technical knowledge of ClickHouse or relevant domains such as SQL databases, OLAP, cloud-native SaaS, DBaaS, or distributed systems. Hands-on experience with databases, data platforms, or related technologies, with the ability to investigate and resolve complex technical problems. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to customers and internal teams. Ability to work effectively in a fully remote and globally distributed environment with reliable connectivity. Availability to participate in the scheduling required to provide high-quality 24x7 support, including relevant coverage for customers across different regions. Strong customer orientation, empathy, teamwork, and relationship-building skills. Self-driven, curious, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of challenging technical issues. Commitment to continuous learning and the ability to adapt quickly to evolving technologies and customer requirements. Nice to have: Experience with ClickHouse, open-source technologies, AWS, Azure, GCP, or data-pipeline technologies such as Kafka, Kinesis, Spark, or RabbitMQ. Nice to have: Experience as an open-source user, community member, or contributor. Benefits Fully remote work from Brazil. Flexible work environment within a globally distributed organization. jobgether-jobgether:lever:e8d28d77-e92c-.title: Business Developer - Trade Finance
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e8d28d77-e92c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Developer – Trade Finance based in Spain. As a Business Developer, you will drive the origination and development of strategic relationships with Trade Finance Institutions. You will identify and prioritize prospective partners while uncovering opportunities that support broader commercial objectives. The role combines financial expertise, relationship management, business development, and technology-enabled market intelligence. You will engage directly with banks, fintechs, clearing institutions, brokerages, and other financial organizations. Modern software and AI-supported techniques will help you research markets, assess prospects, and work efficiently with complex information. You will operate with significant autonomy in a global commodities environment while collaborating closely with commercial teams. The position offers strong performance-based incentives and the opportunity to build a valuable track record in international trade finance. Originate and develop relationships with Trade Finance Institutions in support of strategic business objectives. Identify, assess, and prioritize prospective Trade Finance Institutions using public and proprietary data sources and modern software-based research techniques. Build and maintain relationships with Trade Finance Banks, fintechs, clearing banks, derivatives brokerages, and other relevant financial institutions. Interface directly with representatives of prospective and existing institutions to identify opportunities for collaboration. Work closely with commercial teams to understand business needs and translate them into actionable business development opportunities. Leverage existing institutional relationships and networks to accelerate prospecting and partnership development. Research financial institutions, markets, and counterparties to identify relevant opportunities and assess their strategic potential. Apply data-driven and AI-enabled approaches, including emerging automation and retrieval-based technologies, to improve prospect identification and business development efficiency. Communicate complex financial and commercial concepts clearly and effectively to internal and external stakeholders. Represent the organization professionally in meetings, industry interactions, and relevant business development activities. Build a strong personal track record of successful relationships, transactions, and business development outcomes. Requirements: Demonstrated proficiency in the functions and operation of various trade finance instruments and trade finance credit facilities. Strong understanding of financial statements, including the ability to analyze and interpret relevant financial indicators, KPIs, and ratios. Proven professional experience interfacing directly with Trade Finance Banks or comparable financial institutions. Strong business development and relationship-building capabilities, with the ability to identify opportunities and develop them into meaningful commercial relationships. Genuine curiosity about business process automation and emerging technologies, including the practical use of AI agents and software-enabled research tools. Ability to analyze complex information, identify relevant insights, and prioritize opportunities effectively. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas precisely, concisely, and persuasively. Ability to work independently in a remote, international environment while collaborating effectively with commercial and financial stakeholders. Valid authorization to work in the location of employment; work permit sponsorship is not available. msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.title: Seasonal Custodian Overnight
msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.description: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? The Seasonal Overnight Custodian will be responsible for the cleanliness and organization of their assigned area throughout Radio City on an overnight schedule. What will you do? The Seasonal Overnight Custodian will maintain facility standards and assist in general cleaning. Duties included sweeping floors, cleaning spills, dumping garbage, upkeep of restrooms during events and general maintenance of public areas. Will be able to handle facility equipment of different size and weights. Will receive deliveries and perform additional duties as assigned. Candidate will ensure that MSG standards are always met and exceeded Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site. What do you need to succeed? The ideal candidate will have custodial experience at an entertainment venue or large commercial property. A high level of energy and commitment with strong attention to detail and organizational skills Must possess the ability to handle multiple tasks at a time Must possess the ability to work with various operating groups Special Requirements This is a seasonal position that will be scheduled for the duration of the Radio City Christmas Spectacular. Potential to convert to part time regular role based on business needs and performance may be available to convert to a regular part time role based on performance. Must have the ability to work overnight shifts (10pm-6am, 11pm-7am, 12am-8am) on weekdays, and must be available on weekends and holidays. Must be able to lift up to 50lbs without assistance. Able to walk and stand during the entire shift Must be receptive to working outside in inclement weather and extreme temperatures. Ability to climb and descend multiple flights of stairs while carrying equipment or supplies This position is part-time and scheduled on an event driven basis. Must be able to work within an environment with loud noises and everchanging visuals Ability to stand and move about the theater throughout the duration of the shift. Ability to work a flexible schedule including nights, have split days off, work weekends and holidays in a 24 X 7 environment. Hourly Pay Range $19.52 — $19.52 USD At MSG, we recognize the importance of upskilling employees’ talents and strengths so they can drive their careers forward. We are proud to offer a robust set of tools and resources to help employees understand their interests and purpose, harness their talents and obtain the skills they need to reach the next step in their careers. Growth and longevity for our employees are top priorities here. We value diversity and are looking for extraordinary employees of all backgrounds! qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:5004fe50-402b-4e0b.title: Quality Systems & Manufacturing Manager
qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:5004fe50-402b-4e0b.description: Quality Systems & Manufacturing Manager Location: Columbus, OH Job Type: Direct Hire Starting Salary: $100,000/year (Higher salary available based on experience) Work Split: Approximately 70% desk-based / 30% product and manufacturing floor Position Overview Seeking an experienced quality leader to oversee quality systems and manufacturing quality for a growing industrial operation. This position is responsible for strengthening the Quality Management System (QMS), improving product and process quality, maintaining compliance, and leading continuous improvement initiatives. The role works closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and senior leadership across sheet metal fabrication, busbar fabrication, mechanical assembly, and related manufacturing processes.
responsibilities: Quality Systems & Compliance
Lead and improve the company's Quality Management System (QMS) .
Maintain compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable customer, regulatory, and industry requirements.
Manage internal and external audits, management reviews, corrective actions, and quality documentation.
Maintain effective document control, nonconformance, and change management processes.
Standardize quality procedures and processes across manufacturing operations.
Manufacturing Quality
Establish quality standards and process controls for sheet metal fabrication, busbar fabrication, mechanical assembly , and related operations.
Reduce defects, rework, scrap, and customer complaints .
Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions using structured problem-solving methods.
Partner with Operations and Engineering to improve process capability and product quality.
Develop quality metrics and reporting to track manufacturing performance.
Customer & Supplier Quality
Serve as a senior escalation point for customer quality concerns and corrective actions.
Support customer audits, quality reviews, and qualification activities.
Develop supplier quality processes and performance metrics.
Manage supplier corrective action activities and work with Engineering and Supply Chain to address supplier quality issues.
Leadership & Improvement
Lead, mentor, and develop quality personnel.
Establish staffing, organizational, and capability plans for the quality function.
Build quality awareness and process discipline throughout the organization.
Develop training programs and promote a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement .
Communicate quality trends, risks, performance, and improvement initiatives to senior leadership.
Track cost of quality , including scrap, rework, warranty claims, and customer complaints.
qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Industrial Technology , or a related field.
10+ years of quality leadership experience in a manufacturing environment.
Proven experience leading quality systems, compliance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Strong knowledge of quality management, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and process improvement .
Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing organizational change.
Strong communication, leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:ae672eb3-1184-4b8f.title: Legal Counsel - Platform
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:ae672eb3-1184-4b8f.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз шукаємо Middle/Senior Legal Counsel, який(-а) готовий(-а) занурюватися в бізнес-процеси, працювати з контрактами та розвивати юридичну функцію разом із командою. Завдання, які чекають на цій ролі: - Юридичний супровід української корпоративної структрури, у тому числі проєктів благодійного фонду. - Підготовка, аналіз та узгодження контрактів як в рамках бізнесів, так і для інфраструктурних потреб (у більшості іноземні юрисдикції). - Проведення KYC контрагентів. - Участь у покращенні/автоматизації внутрішніх процесів (у тому числі у зоні контрактів та KYC), роведення тренінгів для підвищення рівня правової культури. - Співпраця з внутрішніми командами для підтримки бізнес-процесів і їх юридичної відповідності (команди бізнесів, фінансисти, аудитори, бухгалтерія та інші). - Консультації щодо юридичних ризиків, змін у регулюванні, поточних питань, що впливають на процеси компанії. - У перспективі — фокус на розвиток напряму контрактів та KYC для окремих бізнесів, а також побудова й автоматизація відповідних процесів. Що для нас важливо: - 3+ роки досвіду в сфері юридичної підтримки бізнесу, що включає структурування бізнесу, договірну частину та інші невідʼємні питання при діяльності бізнесу (базове розуміння міжнародного корпоративного права буде перевагою). - Відмінні навички складання, аналізу та ревʼю контрактів. - Високий рівень самостійності, проактивність. - Орієнтація на практичні рішення, що відповідають цілям бізнесу. - Розуміння бізнес-процесів та здатність бачити загальну картину можливих ризиків. - Англійська: Upper-Intermediate+ — для роботи з контрактами та комунікації. - Готовність до розвитку, багатозадачної роботи та зростання в команді. У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: - SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. - Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. - Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо. - Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави. - Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат — з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше. - Турбота про щоденний комфорт.
